title: [Shopify] Keep gift cards from unverified POS returns on the sales invoice
summary: Modified Shopify gift card handling on POS unverified returns so they remain on sales invoices rather than being treated as exchange items, preventing empty invoice generation with auto-release enabled.
key_points: A gift card on a return with unverified return lines is treated as a regular order line again and invoiced
Fixes empty sales invoices that failed to release when Auto Release was on
Is Exchange Item is now set for every line as it is written, replacing MarkExchangeItemOrderLines, so re-importing fixes orders that were flagged by mistake
Refund import creates no synthetic exchange refund line for these gift cards and removes one left by an earlier import
Verified returns with exchanges behave as before; 7 tests added
quote: A Shopify POS unverified return can only be refunded to a gift card.
